description: This Java class 'FileWatcher' monitors a specified file for changes by periodically checking its hash and triggers callbacks on updates or errors.

classes.name: FileWatcher
classes.description: A class that watches a file for changes by periodically hashing its contents and executing callbacks when changes are detected.

methods.name: getScheduler
methods.description: Returns a singleton ScheduledExecutorService, initializing it if necessary, with a thread pool for scheduled tasks.

methods.name: FileWatcher
methods.description: Constructor that sets up file monitoring with specified update and error handlers.

methods.name: getFileHash
methods.description: Calculates and returns the hash code of the file's contents, or 0 if an IOException occurs.

methods.name: isRunning
methods.description: Returns whether the watcher is active.

methods.name: setRunning
methods.description: Sets the running state of the watcher and cancels scheduled tasks if stopping.

methods.name: setPollPeriod
methods.description: Sets the polling period for file checks.

methods.name: getPollPeriodUnits
methods.description: Returns the time unit used for polling period.

methods.name: setPollPeriodUnits
methods.description: Sets the time unit for the polling period.
